subject: Freeze my membership for September?
body_text: Hey! I'm on the road for work almost all of September and won't be able to get in. Can I freeze instead of cancelling? I'd rather not lose the rate I'm on.

subject: free pass from the beginner post
body_text: Saw the Saturday 9am post and grabbed the free pass. I've never touched a barbell, is that class actually okay for someone starting from zero?

subject: Switching to the 6am
body_text: My hours changed and 5:30 doesn't work anymore. Can I move to the 6am starting next week?

subject: charged twice this month
body_text: I show two charges from you this month. Can you check? Happy to keep the membership, just want the extra one back.

subject: cancelling at the end of the month
body_text: I want to cancel at the end of the month. Work has been brutal and I haven't been in for weeks, so I'm paying for nothing right now.

subject: childcare during the morning classes?
body_text: Is there any childcare in the mornings? That's genuinely the only thing stopping me from coming back.

subject: shoulder is bugging me
body_text: Tweaked my shoulder overhead pressing on Tuesday. Should I skip the barbell club this week or is there something I can do instead?

subject: Bringing a friend Saturday
body_text: Can I bring my sister to the Saturday class? She's visiting from Raleigh and wants to try it.
